RECIPE CARD - TL-5 tank sealing compound (1K PU)
Document: TL-5 tank sealing compound (1K PU)
Batch size: 1,200 kg. Equipment: VD-1, D-4, MS-1, OV-1.
1. Charge 900 kg polyether polyol NP-310 Dry (RM-401) and dry under vacuum at 90 °C
3. Establish a nitrogen blanket on D-4 before the isocyanate addition.
4. Add 280 kg MDI prepolymer (RM-410) at max. 2 kg/min.
6. Hold at 60 °C for 45 min under agitation.
7. Pass the product through magnetic separator MS-1 before canning.
8. Pre-dry empty 5 L cans in oven OV-1 at 60 °C for 2 h.
9. Fill 5 L cans under dry nitrogen and seal.
Controlled copy - the MES recipe is the master.
